'''Venom Assault armor''' was used by [[Venom assault squad]]s of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]]. It was [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]-sealed and allowed the wearer to operate in zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] by using limited jets. It was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in the dark blue and black with red trim motif of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and featured its logo on the shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]].
